decisions.reason: The modular plant concept builds on the firm's core environmental-technology know-how, and its quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros a year gives a clear signal that in-house R&D can build on, though its overlap with the flagship modular line C could lead to consolidation.

The mobile slow-speed shredder sits squarely in the firm's established competence and is easy to service and improve, but the new multi-model slow-speed shredder line E launched in 2024 may absorb it, which raises the chance of replacement.
As the multi-model flagship that carries the firm's modular direction, it draws directly on accumulated know-how and research cooperation, so management will keep developing it.
The new slow-speed shredder line is close to the core offer and has its own page, so the firm can readily assimilate early market feedback and refine the models.

The spiral shaft screen line extends the firm's screening and environmental-technology expertise into a related technology the firm can learn from, although the withdrawal of trommel screen D suggests screening products get closer scrutiny.
